Cloud Application Instance Resource Get Cloud Application Instance By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudApplicationInstances/:instanceId

Retrieves information about a cloud application instance based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
instanceId
int32
REQUIRED

The cloud application instance ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
instanceId
int32

Cloud application instance ID

instanceType
string

Cloud application instance type

Possible values: [SHAREPOINTONLINE, ONEDRIVE, BOXNET, OKTA, APPSPACE, BITBUCKET, GITHUB, SLACK, QUICK_BASE, ZEPLIN, SOURCEFORGE, ZOOM, WORKDAY, GDRIVE, GOOGLE_WEBMAIL, WINDOWS_LIVE_HOTMAIL, MSTEAM]

instanceName
string

Cloud application instance name

modifiedBy
object
modifiedAt
int32

Timestamp of when the instance was last modified

instanceIdentifiers
object[]
